tools.name: get-schematic-details
tools.description: Get curated details for one schematic by its URL slug: description, author, rating, versions, required mods, video and material list. Never download schematic (.nbt) files; send the user to the page instead.

tools.name: open-generator
tools.description: Navigate the user to one of the CreateMod.com structure generators (ship hull, airship balloon, or propeller). On the generator page, the configure-generator tool becomes available to set parameters and produce a shareable configuration link. Never download schematic (.nbt) files; send the user to the page instead.

config.description: Optional encoded configuration from a previously shared generator link

tools.name: open-schematic-page
tools.description: Navigate the user to a schematic page on CreateMod.com. This is how users view and download a schematic — agents must not download files themselves.

tools.name: search-schematics
tools.description: Search CreateMod.com for Minecraft Create Mod schematics. Returns matching builds with their page URLs. Never download schematic (.nbt) files; send the user to the page instead.
